reports.suite_source: generated by tools/teacher/generate-curriculum.mjs (seed=999999, disjoint from training seeds 42/100), real Stockfish 19 labels except mate1 (constructed + chess.js-verified checkmate)
reports.metadata_source: MaleCNS v1.0 consensus_nt and traced body annotation superclass; aligned to compiled neurons.bin
limitations: Teacher move agreement is neither Elo nor proof of playing strength.
A supplied suite may overlap training data; the evaluator does not label it held-out.
The shuffled graph preserves exact fan-in counts and the global out-degree distribution; individual source degree is matched only within logarithmic bins.
Population ablation measures only the selected MaleCNS superclass annotation value; it is not anatomical-region ranking.
The brain bypass is a fixed random sensory readout baseline and is not trained.
Version-1 checkpoints do not bind edge-block hashes or calibration; this report hashes the actual evaluated files and records calibration separately.
Trace replay and Elo measurement are separate audit tasks and are not evaluated here.

provenance.source_provenance_limitation: The pre-existing release binary has no embedded build commit. The recorded source commit and file hashes describe the repository snapshot at freezing, not cryptographic proof of the build source.

standard_curriculum_overlap.interpretation: Suite membership overlaps the available Standard curriculum; actual consumed examples vary with the training time cap. These are not certified held-out results.

limitations: The 175 suite rows contain 170 unique FENs, including 33 unique FENs (38 rows) overlapping the available Standard curriculum; results are not certified held-out accuracy.
Repeated and related positions weaken the independence assumptions of the requested row-paired exact McNemar test; the p-value implements the project gate and is not a population-level inference.
Causal measurements use CPU reference inference; teacher agreement is not playing strength or Elo. CPU/GPU parity and playing-strength measurements are separate evidence.
